newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 20.71 bln Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 20.71 bln Bfr.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury's bond exchange auction on Tuesday totalled 20.71 billion francs, the Treasury said in a statement.

At the auction the Treasury offered OLO lines 13 (7.00 pct, April 1999), 10 (8.75 pct, June 2002), 19 (6.50 pct, March 2005) and 24 (7.00 pct, May 2006) against OLO lines 15 (6.75 pct, May 1997) and 8 (9.25 pct, Aug 1997).
No offers were received to exchange OLO 8. The most popular exchange (for 17.88 billion francs of the total) was OLO 15 into OLO 24, the old 10-year benchmark.
